title: Acquirer: Bundaberg Sugar Ltd; Target: Walkers Limited

body_sections.Summary: Bundaberg Foundry Engineers Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary of Bundaberg Sugar Ltd) proposes to acquire the sugar milling equipment and spare parts business of Walkers Limited.
body_sections.Market definition: For the purposes of the present competition assessment the relevant markets were considered to be the national markets for the supply of sugar mills, shredders, and mill rollers and shells.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Commission determined that no SLC was likely given the potential for imports, low barriers to entry, and countervailing power of customers.
